summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs an obfuscated setup.mjs (obfuscator.io-style _0x identifiers and string-indirection objects) that, when Bun is not already present, downloads the Bun runtime ZIP from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts the platform-specific bun/bun.exe binary, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB Bun-compiled bundle whose body is a rotated string-array with hex-named variables (// @bun @bun-cjs header, string-array rotation via MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())), so its behavior is opaque to Node-based review. The package is advertised as a CSS/theme-tokens library and has no legitimate need for an alternate JavaScript runtime or a large obfuscated bundle. The combination — obfuscated preinstall + alternate-runtime fetch + execution of a heavily obfuscated in-tarball payload under that runtime at npm install time — bypasses Node-oriented scanning and executes attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine on every default install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
